tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The valency shell of element A contains 3 electrons while the valency shell of element $\mathrm{B}$ contains 6 electrons. If A combines with $\mathrm{B}$, the probable formula of the compound formed will be

solution.text: The element A is $\mathrm{ns}^{2} p^{1}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ is $\mathrm{ns}^{2} p^{4}$. They can form compound of the type $\mathrm{A}_{2} \mathrm{~B}_{3}$
